source_reviews.independent_solution: Reused sealed solution: for positive radius r and radian angle phi, arc length l=r*phi, so v=l/t=r*(phi/t)=omega*r, equivalently omega=v/r. With r in metres and omega in rad/s, v is in m/s. For common positive angular speed, v is proportional to radius, not inversely proportional and not independent of radius. The author's derivation uses these same conditions and units.
